flat layout to a nested resources/ subdirectory with fewer parameters
and hardcoded values. This caused terraform to force-replace the RDS
cluster and instances, which would result in data loss.

back to their main branch versions to preserve existing resource
addresses and avoid destructive changes.

Ensure db has been seeded. 2. Run the api and frontend 3. Login to user with applications with applications in the 3 status (submitted, in progress, accepted) 4. Navigate to the application list page 5. Navigate to an application with the Accepted status and verify the following UI: Accepted application Mobile accepted 6. Click the Download submission zip button and ensure the download zip is downloaded and available. 7. Navigate to an application in each of the following statuses and verify the following ui: In progress application Submitted application 8. To verify an application that is in IN_PROGRESS status to > ACCEPTED locally: - Set PDF_GENERATION_USE_MOCKS=true in local.env - Submit form with application - Run `make cmd args="task create-application-submission"` - Reload application and download submission zip
